[[File:Shade icon.png|left]]
The '''Shade''' is a monster located at the first room of the last level of the [[Stronghold of Security]].

In addition to 'Shades' themselves, [[Loar Shade]]s, [[Phrin Shade]]s, [[Riyl Shade]], [[Asyn Shade]]s, and [[Fiyr Shade]]s, which can be found in [[Mort'ton]] or the nearby [[Shade Catacombs]] can also be slain to fulfil the task. To access the shade catacombs, players must have completed the [[Shades of Mort'ton]] quest.

Additional damage can be done to shades through the use of [[Salve amulet (e)|Salve amulets]] or the [[Gadderhammer]] weapon.

==Random event (discontinued)==
When a player buried [[bones]], they had a possibility of angering an aggressive '''Shade''' who would appear and attack them. Shades were transparent in appearance and looked somewhat like a [[ghost]]. As with similar guardian random events, the combat level of a shade varied according to the combat level of the player unfortunate enough to run into one. When slain, the shade usually dropped nothing, but sometimes it would drop an assortment of bones, and on rare occasions, [[shade robes]]. Originally, shades were able to close or open a door without standing beside it, which was unique among all [[Free-to-play|free]] monsters, but this feature was removed.

==Trivia==
* Before [[Evolution of Combat]], it was not very wise to train on shades, because no matter how much damage you inflicted on them, you only received a quarter of the normal experience per hit and only 5% normal slayer experience.
* These were the fourth highest level free-to-play monsters, being tied with [[Cockroach soldier]]s. Many higher level monsters have since been made f2p, and now there are at least 30 different f2p monsters with a higher level.
* Although Shades are transparent, [[Shade robes]] are not.
* Shades have the old idle and walking animations that were used on players before [[RuneScape High Detail]].
* Shades' attack animation is that of slashing a sword, as is their blocking animation. However, they hold no sword at all.
